note: Whole-account single-name exposure, across real holdings and open proposals, on one fund running three managers. Illustrative weights.

scenarios.name: open-proposals-count-before-they-fill
scenarios.why: Another manager's unfilled proposal is exposure this book has already committed to; counting it only after a fill is how a book ends up at twice the limit for one afternoon.

scenarios.name: per-strategy-caps-do-not-sum-into-a-larger-account-limit
scenarios.why: Three managers each allowed 0.12 of one name is not 0.36 of it. The sum is reported as its own finding, because the way that mistake reaches a book is that nobody adds the three numbers up.

scenarios.name: a-proposal-restates-its-own-strategys-holding
scenarios.why: A trim from 0.14 to 0.08 is a target state, not a purchase of 0.08 on top. Summing the two would refuse the trim as a breach.

scenarios.name: one-name-under-two-theses-is-still-one-position
scenarios.why: Two managers both right about the same company is one exposure, and past the account limit it is a breach whichever thesis you read.
